chunks: And in the narration of Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār
The time for the last ʿIshāʾ prayer is until one-third of the night.

key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: the latter, referring to the later evening prayer
key_terms.مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ: the narrator through whom this report is transmitted
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the prescribed time or legal timing

ai.seo_question: Until what point in the night does the time for salat al-ʿIshāʾ extend?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the time of salat al-ʿIshāʾ. It indicates that the time for the later evening prayer extends until one-third of the night, making it relevant to discussions of prayer timings in fiqh.
